page.layout: One printed page, text in a single column on the right; the left edge shows the neighbouring page's text, which is not transcribed. p.i: Sint porrò multiplicationis exempla per utriusq; dati numeri partes. Multiplicentur 1568 per 54: Item numerus 3508476 per 2509, utrobiq; tot factorum ordines procreabuntur, quot multiplicantis cuiuslibet notæ fuerint. Quare confusa factorum scriptio attentè cauenda, curandumq;, ut distinctis factorum ordinibus, initiū cuiusq; sub prima sui multiplicantis nota inueniatur: ut hic uides:

page.notes: The left strip shows fragments of the facing printed page (edge text such as "theo", "ena-", "in se", "uen", "dien-"); these are not part of this page and were left out. The arithmetic lines are set as a sum with a rule between the partial and final results; transcribed as printed. Some letters in the scan are faint, notably in the italic paragraph; the reading follows the clearest forms. The page continues in the next part. The sums are set with rules beneath them; the rules are not transcribed. The left strip is cut off at the left edge of the scan, so its lines are fragments. The faint mirrored text in the middle of the page is show-through and is not transcribed. "CC oo" is uncertain.
